findings.claim: The change does not satisfy all acceptance criteria because phase-completion task 6.3 remains unchecked.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 6.3 is explicitly listed as `- [ ] 6.3 Install/sign/read back the final binary and generation, complete artifact-refiner and distinct-model review, verify/archive the OpenSpec change, and close the KBD phase with reflection` while the packet requires the change to satisfy the acceptance criteria.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete and mark task 6.3 as done only after the final install/sign/readback, review, OpenSpec archive, and phase closure evidence are committed.

findings.claim: The default installer builds with Cargo but then looks for the release binary in the crate-local target directory, which is not where a workspace build normally writes it.
findings.evidence: The script sets `SOURCE_BIN="${PROMETHEUS_EXEC_SOURCE_BIN:-${REPO_ROOT}/crates/prometheus-exec/target/release/prometheus-exec}"` but later runs `cargo build --release --manifest-path "${REPO_ROOT}/crates/prometheus-exec/Cargo.toml"`; for a workspace member this produces `${REPO_ROOT}/target/release/prometheus-exec`, so the following `[ -f "$SOURCE_BIN" ]` check can fail after a successful build.
findings.suggested_fix: Default `SOURCE_BIN` to `${REPO_ROOT}/target/release/prometheus-exec` for workspace builds, or set `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` explicitly to `${REPO_ROOT}/crates/prometheus-exec/target` before building.

findings.claim: The execution doctor does not verify LaunchAgent loaded state even though the release-distribution requirement requires service definition and loaded state verification when requested.
findings.evidence: Requirement `execution-release-distribution`: `Root and component doctor surfaces SHALL verify the execution binary, signature/hash, service definition and loaded state when requested...`; the added `inspect_service_definition` only checks symlink/regular-file status, reads the file, requires it to contain `prometheus-exec` and `daemon`, and hashes it, with no `launchctl` or loaded-state verification.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit requested loaded-state check for the configured service label/path, report failure when the service is not loaded, and keep it non-mutating.
